sparse_carrier_original_geometry.scope: Original S3b geometry (.04m, 3329 cells). Same separate velocity-Verlet integrator for full nonlinear and sparse affine far field, no multirate. Far state dimension is NOT reduced. h and h/2 controls.

wall_scope: S3b with dmin=0.1m (not original 0.04m). Central strip stays nonlinear, complete interface traces retained, remote undamaged secant K linearised at the prestressed initial state. Shared stable microstep, no multirate or contact reduction. Offline dense eigen build is charged separately and in wall time. Gains are CPU work estimates, not GPU timings.

coupled_bundle.note: Same platen mass and link laws. Frame-based admission. The fast fallback is declared energy-limited brittle fracture, not an equivalent cohesive update. CPU f64 priority is a research control, not cross-GPU determinism.

limitations: Dynamic port/CMS controls use dmin=.1m; S4b rigid controls use .08m. Legacy S3b rerun uses original .04m.
Sparse-carrier original-geometry controls also use .04m. The future-damage-mask localization oracle is deliberately noncausal and is NOT an online activation algorithm.
Frozen components have no new rubble contacts in S4b; wake-on-impact is not validated.
A linear far field crossing chi=1 is outside its strict no-damage contract, regardless of a matching total D.
Late raw force histories have their own substantial h/h2 phase error; early force, peak and fracture-history errors are reported separately.
Damped full/frozen runs share a named new 10ms internal damping model. They cannot be presented as unchanged undamped physics.
Capacity scheduling limits admission, not all scene work or GPU frame time. The 10k-link bundle is coupled but is not a 2D/3D rubble test.
